Based solely on the data: no comments on plays.</li><li>Ranks compare the 32 teams of the EuroCup, each on all of its games in it.</li><li>Rank bars: the longer the bar, the higher the team ranks on that item (1st = best value for that team; for possessions per game and style items, 1st = most). On this page a long red bar is an item where the opponent ranks high.</li><li>Last 3 games: only the three most recent games of BC Roma and of the opponent in this competition, ranked against the season values of every other team. Minimum samples are cut to 30% of the season ones. Three games move a lot from one game to the next.</li><li>Who defends it for us: points per possession on the possessions that end on the defender Synergy logs for the last action (season: at least 5 possessions). It does not adjust for who they guarded or for help defense.</li><li>At the rim = 2-point attempts within 6 ft. Points in the paint = field goals only. Open = catch-and-shoot jump shots Synergy tags as open (it tags open / guarded on catch-and-shoot jump shots only). Drives = shots whose Synergy description contains a drive.</li><li>Shot zones need 12 shots to be colored (4 on the last 3 games). Synergy&#x27;s 11 zones, with the paint split into the rim (6 ft) and the rest.</li><li>Shot defenders: Synergy credits every shot allowed to one defender; catch-and-shoot jump shots left open and points per jump shot are counted on those shots (season: at least 10 and 15 shots). Player minutes and offensive rebounds come from Synergy&#x27;s game box scores.</li><li>Offensive rebound % = offensive rebounds / (offensive + opponent defensive rebounds), from Synergy&#x27;s play-by-play stats.</li><li>Not in Synergy (they come from tracking): box-outs, blow-bys, closeouts, contest levels, crashing the glass, passes per chance, pick-and-roll coverages.
